name: agent-session-world
title_zh: 编程会话变成一座会动的 3D 小世界
tagline_zh: 每个会话线程变成一只居民，每个项目变成它们住的地方，线程在干什么决定它在做什么——小机器人在月球、鱼在礁石。
tagline_en: Each session thread becomes an inhabitant, each project becomes its habitat, and what the thread is doing decides.
desc_en: Build someone a living 3D world out of their own coding-agent sessions, in whatever form they ask for — little robots on a moon, fish in a reef, animals in a forest, villagers, ants, boats in a harbour. Each thread becomes an inhabitant, each project becomes somewhere for them to live, and what a thread is really doing decides what its inhabitant does. This skill supplies the structure that makes
why_zh: 不是随机撒点装饰，而是先给会话和项目建结构，再让状态映射成行为，所以世界会随你的真实工作变化。
why_en: It builds structure from your sessions and projects first, then maps state to behavior — so the world actually changes with your.
limit_zh: 只负责生成世界结构与行为映射，不替你渲染成品视频，也不托管在线展厅；本机要有可读的会话记录目录。
limit_en: Only builds world structure and behavior mapping; no rendered video, no hosted gallery. Needs readable local session logs and your own 3D runtime.
title_en: Your coding sessions become a living 3D world
